evidence.title: Pinned GR00T timing harness and applied optimization patch
evidence.observation_period: Experiment date unspecified; tutorial source last changed 2026-08-13; code base 2026-07-08 and patch 2026-07-31
evidence.claim: E2E is an elementwise sum of separately measured preprocessing and synchronized backbone/action-head timings. Default recipe uses episode 0 step 0, with mode-specific warm-ups; it does not measure uninterrupted sensor-to-actuator latency.
evidence.locator: benchmark_inference.py: prepare_model_inputs; compute_e2e_from_components (lines 168–170); benchmark_data_processing; benchmark_components; BenchmarkConfig; main; build_trt_pipeline.py: _run_benchmark and PipelineConfig.workspace
evidence.limitations: CPU-only source inspection. No model, dataset, container, engine or GPU execution. Code configuration identifies default recipe semantics, not proof of exact undisclosed run arguments. No original per-iteration timing arrays recovered.
